note: Gate E W1 — E01 (League temporal orientation, period navigation, context restoration). Two states: mid-season-current-round and season-closed-no-current-round. Both reuse the real, unmodified buildLeagueOperatingViewModel() and LeagueSurface (ADR-0144) via a new fixture-safe URL-state mount (league-fixture-mount.tsx), the same actions-override-mount pattern precedent Gate C W3/Gate D W2 established for self-fetching production components. Unlike every prior Gate A directional study and Gate D's D07/D08/D09, this wave introduces zero new or directional presentation component — 100% real, already-shipped production code. scripts/ui-lab-visual-review.mjs registers both routes for CI capture. Both candidates are CANDIDATE, pending owner review — none approved, none merged, none self-approved. E02-E08 are deferred to later Gate E waves (docs/ui-lab/gate-e-w1-candidates/WAVE_SCOPE.md). REMEDIATION ROUND 1 (independent review, same PR): the mount's header was originally hand-rolled markup instead of the real TouchlinePageHeader/TouchlineButton primitives, a MAJOR finding (BLK-E01-05) directly contradicting the 'zero divergence' claim below — corrected to reuse the real header components verbatim, including the real 'Create match' navigation link (not a mutation, safe to keep). REMEDIATION ROUND 2 (external review, same PR): several manually-authored display labels (period dateRange, round dateRange, one period's title/id) had drifted from their real underlying startDate/endDate/startsAt records — e.g. Round 6 labelled '15 Feb 2027' against a real kickoff of 22 Feb 2027; the season-closed fixture's only period named 'Autumn 2026' against real boundaries entirely in January-February 2027 (renamed 'Winter 2027'). Corrected, fixtureVersion bumped 1 -> 2 on both candidates, fixtureSha256 recomputed, and a new independent reconciliation test layer (__tests__/fixture-temporal-integrity.test.ts) added so a future kickoff edit without a matching label update fails the suite mechanically. The desktop product surface was also found artificially capped at max-w-[720px] against the real app shell's max-w-[96rem] (E01-R2) — corrected, with a real 1440px-viewport width assertion added. DATA_TRUTH_AND_FIXTURES.md's match count ('eleven') was corrected to the real count ('ten'), independently asserted from the fixture records. Documentation that still claimed 'Create match' was omitted (it is rendered; only 'Generate all draft squads' is) was corrected across INTERACTION_AND_STATE_AUDIT.md/WAVE_SCOPE.md/this manifest. 'Context restoration' acceptance language was clarified to distinguish default-focus re-resolution (what period-switching proves) from real selected-context restoration (direct URL load, browser Back, now covered by new Playwright tests) per XR-T01's actual text, and real keyboard-interaction tests (ArrowRight+Enter on the rail, ArrowDown on the season select) were added. capture-attestation.json reflects a fresh CI run against this remediated code — see REVIEW_RECORD.md for the full account of both remediation rounds.
